items.text: The harbour had room for 1,200 ships by 1850.
The harbour held 1,500 ships in 1850 near Dover.
Over a thousand ships came in March, and Smith's boats too.
Here fishermen sold their catch at the market each morning before sunrise.

claims.quote: A lighthouse stood on the eastern pier

sources.town: The harbour held 1,200 ships in 1850. A lighthouse stood on the eastern pier, and fishermen sold their catch at the market each morning before sunrise. In the Harbour Age the Tōkaidō road ran past Kadıköy. It’s said the “old quay” — rebuilt in 1851 — held a thousand barrels.
